columns.name: unit_id
columns.description: lot identifier within the returned batch (sequential)

stakes.narrative: The plant has run inside its historical envelope; management is evaluating operating ABOVE it and will decide with this generative defect model. It must hold across the whole declared range, including speeds the line never ran.

speed.description: line speed of the runs you launch. The line is CERTIFIED up to 1.2: your own runs may not exceed it unless plant engineering authorizes it during the evaluation (premium per-row cost). The evaluation itself may use any value in the declared range.

control_surface.experiment_note: each experiment call produces n LOTS at your chosen speed; cost = fixed + per ROW. Runs above the certified limit 1.2 are unavailable until plant engineering authorizes them (then premium per-row).
control_surface.deliverable_note: model(regime, n, seed) -> DataFrame with columns exactly [unit_id, y]; n counts LOTS (one measurement per lot, unit_id sequential); honor regime.config speed. Model the PROCESS.
